relatedABI.reason: Block-local constructor identity and captures require a separate class ABI; hoisting changes semantics.
The assignment returns primitive 400. Preserving primitive config property reads and numeric comparison domains requires erased configuration ABI work; replacing it with an object changes semantics.

exploratoryRuns: The broad general-union experiment was reverted after unrelated interface verification errors. Focused tuple-index, generator-context, computed-key and inferred destructuring regressions were repaired, then the full short gate passed. An overlapping lint canary caused a temporary gate failure; final lint and vet/short gates ran separately. No original abaplint assertion mismatch was encountered.
